name: cascading-failure
description: RDBMS connection pool exhaustion cascades into API timeouts, an MCP host failure, and a cache miss storm, then recovers. Sample failure-event data for the assignment's 'mock a failure event across the stack' requirement (RDBMS outage followed by an MCP failure).
notes: This file is the canonical, static event sequence — cascading-failure.ts reads it at runtime and replays it exactly as written, scaled only by the --speed flag. Nothing here is regenerated or duplicated by hand in the .ts file.

Each signal's `severity` is what the (simulated) monitoring source reported. The backend's alerting Strategy pattern applies a per-componentType severity FLOOR on top of this when it dispatches an alert (RDBMS=P0, API/MCP_HOST/NOSQL/QUEUE=P1, CACHE=P2 — see backend/src/domain/alerting/strategies/). The rdbms-failure beat deliberately reports P1 (an automated monitor under-calling a connection-pool warning is realistic) so the replay can demonstrate the floor actually correcting it up to P0 in the dispatched alert, not just trivially matching what was already sent.

role: 'incident' components are the ones this scenario's failure narrative is about; 'baseline' components represent the rest of a normally-operating fleet and never fail in this scenario — both create work items (any signal does), which is what gives the dashboard a realistic mix after replay-lifecycle.ts closes only the 'incident' ones.

beats.label: Baseline healthy traffic
beats.narration: Normal background signal traffic across every component type — occasional low-severity blips, nothing actionable.

beats.label: RDBMS primary begins failing
beats.narration: Connection pool exhaustion errors on DB_PRIMARY_01, rising from a trickle to a flood over 15s. Reported severity is P1 — expect the dispatched alert to be corrected up to P0 by RDBMS's Strategy floor.

beats.label: Dependent API services start timing out
beats.narration: Three API components time out waiting on the backed-up database.

beats.label: MCP host fails
beats.narration: MCP_HOST_01 fails as its downstream dependency (the database) stays unavailable.

beats.label: Cache miss storm
beats.narration: Services fall back to the failing database on every cache miss — CACHE_SESSION_01 reports a storm of misses, ramping over 20s.

beats.label: Partial recovery
beats.narration: Error rates decline across every previously-failing component as the database recovers.

beats.label: Steady state restored
beats.narration: No new signals — buffer fully drained, error rate back to baseline. The cascade is over.
